thread:
zara: quick PSA  noticed a batch of fncall validation failures that still surface as billed tool runs in Console. example payload below

zara: ```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "db_lookup", "args": ["user:123"]}}
```

leo: can you paste the validator output?

zara: `validation error: expected object at /tool_call/args, got array`

mike: yep adapter never executed. current pipeline increments invoke cost immediately and adapter later flips `tool_run` tag when it actually runs. if adapter never runs, billing attribution is wrong.

leo: policy question: do we bill pre-adapter rejects? i'm leaning no, but we must be careful about abuse. need tamper-proof signal.

mike: proposal: emit internal-only metadata: `meta.validation_outcome=reject_pre_adapter`, `meta.validation_cause=type_mismatch`, and set `meta.billing_applied=false`. keep these under route.meta so SDKs/APIs don't change. also write a telemetry counter `validation.reject_pre_adapter` and a sampled payload id for audits.

zara: Console UX: show a discrete state "Validation reject 1 no tool run" with orange indicator and link to sampled payload (for CS/ops). right now they just see cost and panic.

leo: rollout idea: 1) add internal tags + metrics, 2) small canary (2-5%) where we hold billing for these rejects, 3) sample payloads for 30d, 4) run fraud detection over samples, 5) if green after 2w flip default.

mike: implementation notes: - do NOT expose fields on public RPCs; keep internal only - add unit tests that simulate adapter not invoked and assert `billing_applied=false` - cover streaming fncall where first chunk parses but subsequent payloads fail (edgecase) - update billing reconciliation docs.

zara: i'll draft the Console card and text for Support. please include a "why this was free" tooltip explaining we withheld billing due to pre-adapter schema failure.

billing-bot: action: starting canary rollout `fncall-prevalidate-billhold` -> eng-runtime-canary (3% traffic). CI: 22 tests passed, 1 infra warning. :rocket:

leo: i'll own PR for telemetry + runtime flag and add metric `validation.reject_pre_adapter.sampled_count`. mike: can you add the unit/e2e tests and analytics hooks?

mike: on it. i'll also add an alert rule in Console: if validation_rejects rate spikes AND billed tool_cost increases in same 1h window, auto-open a triage card listing top routes and sample ids. tagging @console-ui for visibility. :thumbsup:
